name: healthlake
description: This is the AWS HealthLake API Reference.

subcommands.name: create-data-transformation-profile
subcommands.description: Creates a data transformation profile in DRAFT state.

subcommands.name: create-fhir-datastore
subcommands.description: Create a FHIR-enabled data store.

subcommands.name: delete-data-transformation-profile
subcommands.description: Deletes a data transformation profile and all its versions, including the DRAFT and all published versions.

subcommands.name: delete-fhir-datastore
subcommands.description: Delete a FHIR-enabled data store.

subcommands.name: describe-data-transformation-job
subcommands.description: Describes a data transformation job, including its current status, configuration, and progress information.

subcommands.name: describe-fhir-datastore
subcommands.description: Get properties for a FHIR-enabled data store.

subcommands.name: describe-fhir-export-job
subcommands.description: Get FHIR export job properties.

subcommands.name: describe-fhir-import-job
subcommands.description: Get the import job properties to learn more about the job or job progress.

subcommands.name: get-data-transformation-profile
subcommands.description: Retrieves a data transformation profile's metadata and profile content at a specific version.

subcommands.name: list-data-transformation-jobs
subcommands.description: Lists data transformation jobs for your AWS account.

subcommands.name: list-data-transformation-profile-versions
subcommands.description: Lists all versions of a specific data transformation profile (DRAFT and published), in reverse chronological order (newest first).

subcommands.name: list-data-transformation-profiles
subcommands.description: Lists all data transformation profiles in your account, returning the latest version summary for each.

subcommands.name: list-fhir-datastores
subcommands.description: List all FHIR-enabled data stores in a user’s account, regardless of data store status.

subcommands.name: list-fhir-export-jobs
subcommands.description: Lists all FHIR export jobs associated with an account and their statuses.

subcommands.name: list-fhir-import-jobs
subcommands.description: List all FHIR import jobs associated with an account and their statuses.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all existing tags associated with a data store.

subcommands.name: publish-data-transformation-profile
subcommands.description: Promotes the current DRAFT version of a data transformation profile to a new immutable published version.

subcommands.name: start-data-transformation-job
subcommands.description: Starts an asynchronous data transformation job that converts source files from Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) and writes the output to Amazon S3 or AWS HealthLake.

subcommands.name: start-fhir-export-job
subcommands.description: Start a FHIR export job.

subcommands.name: start-fhir-import-job
subcommands.description: Start importing bulk FHIR data into an ACTIVE data store.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Add a user-specifed key and value tag to a data store.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Remove a user-specifed key and value tag from a data store.

subcommands.name: update-data-transformation-profile
subcommands.description: Updates the DRAFT version (version 0) of a data transformation profile with new profile content.

subcommands.name: update-fhir-datastore
subcommands.description: Update the properties of a FHIR-enabled data store.

subcommands.name: update-profile-with-agent
subcommands.description: Updates a data transformation profile using chat-based interaction with an agent.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: data-transformation-job-completed
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query TransformationJobProperties.JobStatus returns COMPLETED when polling with ``describe-data-transformation-job``.

subcommands.name: fhir-datastore-active
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query DatastoreProperties.DatastoreStatus returns ACTIVE when polling with ``describe-fhir-datastore``.

subcommands.name: fhir-datastore-deleted
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query DatastoreProperties.DatastoreStatus returns DELETED when polling with ``describe-fhir-datastore``.

subcommands.name: fhir-export-job-completed
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query ExportJobProperties.JobStatus returns COMPLETED when polling with ``describe-fhir-export-job``.

subcommands.name: fhir-import-job-completed
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query ImportJobProperties.JobStatus returns COMPLETED when polling with ``describe-fhir-import-job``.
